held.text: A 60-year-old male is suffering from difficulty in initiation of any motor activity. While sitting he is having tremor in his hand which stops during any activity. Doctors also noted, along with change of emotions, there is no change in facial expression. i) What is your probable diagnosis? ii) Explain the pathophysiology of the disease with a diagram. iii) [Printed repeated subpart struck out; handwritten replacement requires independent confirmation.] iv) Name two drugs used to reduce hypokinesia in this patient. v) What type of rigidity is seen in this patient and how does it differ from the rigidity of upper motor neuron lesion? 1+6+3+2+3
held.reason: Whole 15-mark unit held: printed iii repeated/struck through and handwritten replacement of uncertain authority/reading; do not silently substitute or omit the required subpart.
